A '''geometric sequence''' is a [[number sequence]] where each term after the first is a fixed multiple of the previous one.

== Formal definition ==

$(a_n)$ is a '''geometric sequence''' if:

$$
a_n=a_0q^n
$$

$q=\frac{a_{n}}{a_{n-1}},\, \forall n \ge 1$ is known as the '''common ratio''' of the sequence.

== Properties ==

=== Partial sum: $S_m$ ===

The sum of first $m$ terms of a geometric sequence is known as its '''partial sum''' up to the $m$th term, denoted by $S_n$.

$$
S_n=\frac{a^{m+1}-a_0}{q-1}
$$
